decisions.reason: This multi-model formwork profile system builds directly on the firm's core engineering and modular formwork knowledge, so despite missing later website evidence it is still more likely to be retained and improved than withdrawn.
The automated concrete distributor flow control fits the firm's automation strategy and in-house R&D base, giving management good scope to learn from use and refine it commercially rather than exit.

The shuttering magnet block is close enough to the established formwork business to benefit from existing know-how, but its lower prominence and overlap with other magnetic products raise the risk of later portfolio pruning.
Magnetic formwork strips are highly complementary to the firm's integrated systems and service offering, which makes continued retention more attractive than taking them off the market.

This magnetic formwork component remains close to the firm's existing technical base and was important enough to receive standalone presentation, although some consolidation risk exists within the magnetic accessory range.

Because this lower-prominence magnetic formwork component appears most exposed to overlap within the modular portfolio, management is likeliest to rationalize it and shift resources to stronger core products and new development.
